modalTitle.message: How to get your Google AI Studio API Key

modalStep1.message: Open the API Keys page: Go to the Google AI Studio API Keys page and sign in with your Google account. No separate Gemini account or payment is needed.

modalStep2.message: New to AI Studio: Accept the terms. AI Studio creates a project and an API key for you. Copy the key.

modalStep3.message: Used AI Studio or Google Cloud before: Click Create API key. For free use, choose a project without billing, or add a new one under Dashboard › Projects.

modalStep4.message: Paste the key: Paste it into Google Gemini API Key in GirlsinSight's settings and click Verify.

modalStep5.message: Free tier: Free daily limits depend on the model and are shown in AI Studio. Each analysis uses about two requests. A project with billing is charged instead, and a prepaid project stops when its credits run out.

modelUnavailable.message: This API key can't use Gemini 3.6 Flash or newer, which GirlsinSight needs.

rateLimited.message: Gemini's rate limit was reached. Wait a minute, then try again.

progressThinkingNote.description: $1 is the running step; $2 is the heading of Gemini's latest thinking note, in Gemini's own words.

geminiBusy.message: Gemini is too busy to answer right now. When demand is high, free-tier requests are the first to be turned away. Try again in a few minutes.

geminiDailyLimitRetryingWithModel.message: $1 has reached today's free limit. Trying again with $2 (try $3 of $4)…

geminiBusyRetryingWithModel.message: $1 is busy. Trying again with $2 (try $3 of $4)…

prepaidCreditsDepleted.message: This API key's Google project uses prepaid billing and its credits have run out. Add credits in Google AI Studio, or use a key from a new project without billing to use the free tier.

sentimentIncomplete.message: The analysis was cut off before it finished. Try again, or analyze fewer comments.

errorWhy_noKey.message: GirlsinSight needs a Gemini API key to analyze topics. Getting one is free.

errorSteps_noKey.message:
Open the AI Studio API Keys page and sign in with your Google account.
Copy the key AI Studio made for you, or click Create API key.
Paste it in Settings and click Verify.

errorWhy_keyRejected.message: The key may be mistyped or deleted. Older keys that aren't restricted to the Gemini API are also no longer accepted.

errorSteps_keyRejected.message:
Open the AI Studio API Keys page.
Create a new key.
Paste it in Settings and click Verify.

errorTitle_creditsDepleted.message: This key's project has run out of credits

errorWhy_creditsDepleted.message: The key belongs to a Google project with prepaid billing and a $0 balance. Google blocks that project. It does not fall back to the free tier.

errorSteps_creditsDepleted.message:
Open the AI Studio API Keys page.
Create a key in a project without billing.
Paste it in Settings and click Verify.

errorTitle_busy.message: Gemini is too busy right now

errorWhy_busy.message: When demand is high, Google turns away free-tier requests first. GirlsinSight already tried again, including with another model.

errorSteps_busy.message:
Wait a few minutes.
Click Try again.

errorWhy_rateLimited.message: The free tier allows a limited number of requests per minute and per day.

errorSteps_rateLimited.message:
Wait a minute, then click Try again.
If it happens again, the daily limit is used up. Try again tomorrow.

errorTitle_noModel.message: This key can't use the models GirlsinSight needs

errorWhy_noModel.message: GirlsinSight needs Gemini 3.6 Flash or newer, and this key's project doesn't offer it.

errorSteps_noModel.message:
Open the AI Studio API Keys page.
Create a key in a new project.
Paste it in Settings and click Verify.

errorWhy_pageUnreadable.message: The page may have changed since it loaded, or GirlsinSight was updated after the page was opened.

errorSteps_pageUnreadable.message:
Click Reload page.
Run the analysis again.

errorWhy_other.message: Something went wrong while analyzing this topic.

errorSteps_other.message:
Click Try again.
If it keeps failing, reload the topic page and try again.
